metas.name: Peep Show
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Spaced

Mark and Jez are a couple of twenty-something roommates who have nothing in common - except for the fact that their lives are anything but normal. Mayhem ensues as the pair strive to cope with day-to-day life.

metas.name: The Twilight Zone
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

Tales of science fiction, fantasy and the occult.

metas.name: Will & Grace
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Friends

Gay lawyer Will and straight interior designer Grace share a New York City apartment. Their best friends are gleeful and proud gay Jack and charismatic, filthy-rich, amoral socialite Karen.

metas.name: The Man in the High Castle
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved For All Mankind

In a dystopian America dominated by Nazi Germany and Imperial Japan, a young woman discovers a mysterious film that may hold the key to toppling the totalitarian regimes.

metas.name: Brothers & Sisters
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched The Madison

The story of the drama surrounding a family's adult siblings.

metas.name: Silo
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Station Eleven

Men and women live in a giant silo underground with several regulations which they believe are in place to protect them from the toxic and ruined world on the surface.

metas.name: Are We There Yet?
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair

Based on the hit film, centers on the blended Kingston-Persons of Seattle facing the challenges of everyday life in a new blended family.

metas.name: The Code
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Half Man

Two Canberra based brothers become entangled in a cover up that involves a remote outback community and key members of the Australian Government.

metas.name: The Young Ones
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Spaced

The crazy and sometimes surreal comedic adventures of four very different students in Thatcher's Britain.

metas.name: Night Gallery
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

Rod Serling presents tales of horror illustrated in various paintings.

metas.name: Don't Trust the B---- in Apartment 23
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Friends

A naive young woman finds herself with a wild roommate when she moves to New York.

metas.name: The Expanse
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved For All Mankind

The disappearance of rich-girl-turned-political-activist links the lives of a Ceres detective, an accidental ship captain and U.N. politician. Amidst political tension between Earth, Mars and the Belt, they unravel the greatest co...

metas.name: Everwood
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched The Madison

A widowed brain surgeon from Manhattan moves his two children to the small mountain town of Everwood, Colorado.

metas.name: Foundation
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Station Eleven

A complex saga of humans scattered on planets throughout the galaxy all living under the rule of the Galactic Empire.

metas.name: One Day at a Time
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair

The misadventures of a divorced mother, her family and their building superintendent in Indianapolis.

metas.name: Brotherhood
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Half Man

Set in an Irish neighborhood in Providence, Rhode Island, the series revolves around two brothers on opposite sides of the law: one a gangster (Jason Isaacs) and the other a state politician (Jason Clarke).

metas.name: Not Going Out
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Spaced

A slacker named Lee navigates life alongside his best friend Tim, his struggling landlady, his love interest Lucy, and Tim's well-meaning but clueless girlfriend Daisy.

metas.name: Night Visions
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

"Night Visions" was a hosted anthology series similar to "The Twilight Zone" - some tales are supernatural, others are just commentaries on twisted human nature. Each hour show is made up of two half-hour stories aired back-to-back.

metas.name: What I Like About You
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Friends

When Holly's father is transferred to Japan, she is sent to live with her big sister Valerie in New York City, turning Valerie's life upside down.

metas.name: Fallout
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved For All Mankind

In a future, post-apocalyptic Los Angeles brought about by nuclear decimation, citizens must live in underground bunkers to protect themselves from radiation, mutants and bandits.

metas.name: Departure
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched The Madison

A high-octane conspiracy series that follows the mystery of Flight 716 - a passenger plane that vanishes over the Atlantic Ocean.

metas.name: War of the Worlds
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Station Eleven

Pockets of survivors are forced to team up after mankind is all but wiped out by a devastating extra-terrestrial attack.

metas.name: Living Single
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair

Follows the lives of several single male and female roommates and friends in 1990s Brooklyn, New York.

metas.name: This Is Us
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Half Man

A heartwarming and emotional story about a unique set of triplets, their struggles, and their wonderful parents.

metas.name: The Inbetweeners
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Spaced

Follows four friends and their antics during their final years of school.

metas.name: Doctor Who
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

The adventures in time and space of the Doctor, a Time Lord who changes appearance and personality by regenerating when near death, and is joined by companions in battles against aliens and other megalomaniacs.

metas.name: The Jeffersons
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Friends

Wealthy African American dry cleaner George Jefferson, his wife Louise, and son Lionel move into a luxury apartment building and develop occasionally fractious relations with other tenants, including their sassy maid Florence.

metas.name: Raised by Wolves
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved For All Mankind

Androids are tasked with raising human children on a mysterious planet.

metas.name: Parenthood
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched The Madison

The lives and tragedies of the Braverman family tree.

metas.name: The Walking Dead: The Ones Who Live
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Station Eleven

The love story between Rick and Michonne. Changed by a world that is constantly changing, will they find themselves in a war against the living or will they discover that they too are The Walking Dead?

metas.name: The Odd Couple
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair

Two men, a neat freak and a slob separated from their wives, have to live together despite their differences.

metas.name: Almost Family
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Half Man

A woman who grew up as an only child discovers that her dad fathered many other children as a sperm donor.

metas.name: Dream On
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Spaced

Martin Tupper's a recently divorced book editor in Manhattan. Martin's life is filled with fantasies and sexual thoughts, many times coming in the form of black-and-white shots from old TV shows and films.

metas.name: The Langoliers
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

Most of the passengers on an airplane disappear, and the remainder land the plane in a mysteriously barren airport.

metas.name: The Exes
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Friends

A group of divorced friends tries to get back to the single life.

metas.name: Star Trek: Picard
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved For All Mankind

Follow-up to Star Trek: The Next Generation (1987) that centers on Jean-Luc Picard in the next chapter of his life.

metas.name: Chasing Life
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched The Madison

April Carver, whose world has just started to look up, is diagnosed with leukemia. With the support of her family and best friend, she might just be able to fight it.

metas.name: The Leftovers
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Station Eleven

Three years after the disappearance of 2% of the global human population, a group of people in a small New York community try to continue their lives while coping with the tragedy of the unexplained nature of the event.

metas.name: Marlon
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair

A loving but immature father with a larger-than-life personality is committed to co-parenting his two kids with his very-together ex-wife. For Marlon, family always comes first--even if he's the biggest kid of all.

metas.name: Bloodline
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Half Man

A family is forced to face their past secrets and scars when the black sheep returns home.

metas.name: Harlem
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Spaced

A group of four friends follow their dreams after graduating from college together.

metas.name: Seven Days
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

An ex-CIA is the point man for a government organization dedicated to time traveling to correct errors that occurred in the previous week.

metas.name: The King of Queens
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Friends

Deliveryman Doug Heffernan has a good life: He has a pretty wife (Carrie), a big television, and friends with which to watch it. Then Carrie's goofy, annoying father Arthur moves in with them.

metas.name: Travelers
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved For All Mankind

Hundreds of years from now, surviving humans discover how to send consciousness back through time, into people of the 21st century, while attempting to change the path of humanity.

metas.name: Party of Five
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched The Madison

Five siblings raise each other following their parents' untimely deaths.

metas.name: Mama's Family
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair

Mama's Family originated with Thelma "Mama" Harper, and her younger sister Fran living together in Mama's house.

metas.name: The Haunting of Hill House
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Half Man

Flashing between past and present, a fractured family confronts haunting memories of their old home and the terrifying events that drove them from it.

metas.name: Drifters
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Spaced

After graduating from university, twenty something year-olds Meg, her cousin Bunny and their friend Laura share a flat and face the ups and downs of love and life.

metas.name: Are You Afraid of the Dark?
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

A group of teenagers meet in the woods, and tell scary stories.

metas.name: Gimme Gimme Gimme
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Friends

Raucous 90s sitcom starring Kathy Burke and James Dreyfus as awful flatmates. Tom is an out-of-work actor with a sharp tongue, and Linda La Hughes is his dysfunctional friend.

metas.name: Salvation
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched The Madison

An MIT grad student and a tech superstar bring a low-level Pentagon official a staggering discovery--that an asteroid is just six months away from colliding with Earth.

metas.name: My Three Sons
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair

Widower Steve Douglas raises three sons with the help of his father-in-law, and is later aided by the boys' great-uncle. An adopted son, a stepdaughter, wives, and another generation of sons join the loving family in later seasons.

metas.name: The Affair
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Half Man

An exploration of the psychological effects and the emotional fallout of an extramarital affair.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Spaced

A look into the nightly lives of four vampires who have lived together on Staten Island for over a century.

metas.name: Doctor Who
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

Continuing on from Doctor Who (1963), this revival follows the further adventures of the Doctor and their companions as they encounter various alien threats and save civilizations on different planets and time periods.

metas.name: Game-On
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Friends

The misadventures of three twenty-something flatmates, bound together by circumstance. Mandy is sexually active, Martin is sexually inactive, and their troubled landlord Matthew never leaves the flat.

metas.name: Life in Pieces
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair

A family comedy told through the separate stories of different family members.

metas.name: Mayans M.C.
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Half Man

A prospect in the Mayans M.C. charter on the California-Mexico border struggles with his desire for vengeance against the cartel and his need for respect from the women he loves.

metas.name: Absolutely Fabulous
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Spaced

The wild misadventures of Edina "Eddy" Monsoon and her best friend Patsy Stone, who live in a nearly constant haze of drugged, drunken selfishness.

metas.name: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

A prequel to Star Trek (1966), this series follows the crew of the USS Enterprise under the command of Captain Christopher Pike.
